Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From golf +‎ -ista.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [ɡulˈfis.tə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [ɡolˈfis.ta]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Noun

[edit]

golfista m or f by sense (plural golfistes)

  1. golfer

Derived terms

[edit]
  • golfístic

Further reading

[edit]
  • “golfista”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007

Noun

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ɡowˈfis.tɐ/ [ɡoʊ̯ˈfis.tɐ]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ɡowˈfis.tɐ/ [ɡoʊ̯ˈfis.tɐ]
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /ɡowˈfiʃ.tɐ/ [ɡoʊ̯ˈfiʃ.tɐ]
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ɡowˈfis.ta/ [ɡoʊ̯ˈfis.ta]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ɡolˈfiʃ.tɐ/ [ɡoɫˈfiʃ.tɐ], /ɡɔlˈfiʃ.tɐ/ [ɡɔɫˈfiʃ.tɐ]

Noun

golfista m or f by sense (plural golfistas)
